description: This Java source file defines the class BeanStreamPayment, an implementation of the PaymentModule interface for integrating with BeanStream payment gateway. It handles different payment operations such as authorization, capture, refund, and transaction processing, communicating with BeanStream via HTTP POST requests and parsing responses accordingly.

classes.name: BeanStreamPayment
classes.description: Implementation of PaymentModule interface for managing payment transactions with BeanStream gateway, including authorization, capture, refund, and communication handling.

methods.name: initTransaction
methods.description: Initializes a payment transaction (currently a stub, returns null).

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Performs payment authorization by processing a transaction with type AUTHORIZE.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Captures a pre-authorized transaction by sending a capture request to BeanStream.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Performs combined authorization and capture transaction.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund or void transaction with BeanStream, handling HTTP communication and response parsing.

methods.name: sendTransaction
methods.description: Sends a payment transaction to BeanStream via HTTP POST, handles the response, and returns a Transaction object.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the BeanStream response map into a Transaction object.

methods.name: formatUrlResponse
methods.description: Parses URL-encoded response string into a map of key-value pairs.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the configuration keys required for the payment module and throws validation errors if missing.
